title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony — Episode2 A New Sound

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all here.
Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Miku♪ Hi, Luka♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As peppy as ever, I see Saki.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did something good happen?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We were talking about what we should be doing if we're serious about going pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And we decided to play a show at the live house I work at as part of gaining more experience as a band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, a show?
That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
It's time to let the world know that Leo/need has finally arrived! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The world? That may be going a little too far, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the thought of setting out into the world could give us some extra motivation.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That also means we'll have to practice even more, you know?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, we get it!
This is what we chose, so we'll just have to do our best♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's why we're gonna need your help more than ever now, Miku. Please!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course I'll help.
We can practice as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. We'll be more than happy to keep supporting you girls however we can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly! Feel free to ask us about anything you like and we'll try to help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now then, how about we get started with practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sounds good! Let's make today another...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh no! Everyone's already here?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Talk about a late entry! MEIKO, why didn't you tell me about what was going on?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. I'm sorry, Rin.
You were sound asleep and I didn't want to disturb you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What...?! Rin?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're the ones who created this SEKAI, right? It's nice to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm Kagamine Rin♪
I'll be a part of Miku-P's band from now on!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to working with all of you☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku-P...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Grumble*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What a cute nickname.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See? It's so much cuter and easier than just calling you by your regular name♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So if you don't mind, I'll be doing the same for all of you too♪ Sakki, Ichi, Hona and Shihoppy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh, okay. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shihoppy...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
H-Hehe. Oh no...
She did it to your name too, Shiho... Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness. At least we have each other, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, but can you give me a different nickname?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! Why?!
It's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, it's not.
I'm certain that Saki's gonna start copying you too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But your name sounds so much cuter that way...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with her♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Please, Rin, can't you think of something else...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You want me to change it that badly...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... What about Shih?
Yeah! How does that sound?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine... It's better than before...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thanks, Shih♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry, Miku-P. Looks like you're all alone now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Grumble*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Things are gonna be so much more fun now that Rin's here with us♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that reminds me. When you came here, MEIKO, you mentioned something about our feelings moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Does that mean you're here because of the same reason, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The reason I came to this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm not really sure...
When I realized it, I was here so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It may be because you all decided to “go pro” together and gave yourselves a new challenge to face, no...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think she's right!
I want to help you just like Miku-P and Luka do!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They even mentioned that they'll be performing in a show. You seem to have arrived just at the right time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? You're gonna put on a show?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we are. Well, we just decided to just a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
Have you already decided on what you're gonna play?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, not quite...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We don't know what we'll be playing yet, but we at least know what we want to do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our goal is to play music that can move the hearts of those who come and listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so nice! Pure friendship! I can tell how committed you are to each other!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't forget to ask if you ever need any help too! I'll do whatever I can to make sure your show's as happy and fun as it can be♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then let's start practicing for it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's make today another good one!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow... I'm beat...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we have to be able to do better than this if we're serious about becoming professionals.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How did my singing sound just now, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You sounded good.
And you'll sound even better once you're pitch-perfect throughout the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay...
Got it. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, can you do me next?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have such a steady beat now, Honami, but your rimshots during the second verse were a little weak. Your rhythm is fine, so just hit it like you mean it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's exactly the part I was worried about. Thank you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your fingers aren't keeping up during some key changes and you have a tendency to go a little too fast, so you might want to work on your finger rolls.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But I'm so bad at that part...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I practiced so much and still haven't gotten it down...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're playing the part before your synth solo much better now, so try to keep in mind what you've been doing there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay! Let me write that down...
The part before my solo... Got it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you've all improved so much compared to before. Let's keep this up and get ready for our show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (*Sigh*... I still have so much work to do...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I wasn't able to play the piano for so long since I was in the hospital. Am I holding everyone back...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time for any of that. I need to keep practicing...!)
